title: LED color source registry (per-maker TOML)
description: Cited LED colors stamped onto boards/*.json by scripts/sync_led_colors.py. Every entry quotes a fetched vendor source: the verify-or-omit rule means a color with no quotable citation is left absent, not guessed. See README.md for the prose schema.

files.description: Every boards/ JSON these banks apply to, relative to boards/. A bank that matches no LED in a given file is a no-op, which is how a file carrying only one of a board's banks is handled.

bank.description: One entry per LED bank -- a consecutive same-name run in the board JSON's leds[].

color.description: Mirrors the board schema's component color: a named color or #RRGGBB.

source.description: The fetched vendor source, quoted. A cited color outranks the LED-name heuristic in scripts/led_metadata.py.
